ja.title: Gedatolisibの休薬週に投与を移すと曝露はどう変わるか
ja.summary: 公表PopPKモデルで同じ540 mg/28日を3回または4回に配分し、ピークと第4週の曝露を比較。2,048組の条件付き仮想個体で検討した。効果・毒性・回復は計算していない。
ja.seo_description: 公表された4-compartment PopPKモデルを用い、gedatolisibの540 mg/28日を3回または4回に配分した仮想条件を比較する。ピークは下がるが、第4週の曝露は増える。臨床上の優劣は結論しない。

en.title: Gedatolisib: how redistributing a 540 mg cycle shifts exposure into the rest week
en.summary: A public four-compartment PopPK model compares 540 mg per 28 days given as 3 or 4 doses. Conditional simulations in 2,048 virtual individuals separate a lower peak from higher week-4 exposure, without efficacy, toxicity or recovery claims.
en.seo_description: A published four-compartment PopPK model is used to compare gedatolisib 540 mg per 28 days as 3 or 4 doses. The peak falls while week-4 exposure rises; no clinical superiority is concluded.

english.title: Gedatolisib: redistributing exposure into the rest week
english.summary: A public four-compartment PK model compares equal 540 mg cycle amounts. Conditional paired simulations separate lower peaks from increased last-week exposure, without clinical benefit claims.
